pools.name: Solana Foundation Delegation Program
pools.summary: The Foundation delegates SOL to eligible validators to support decentralization. Not a stake pool, but the largest single delegation source.
pools.howToApply: Register at solana.org/delegation-program: run a testnet node, complete KYC, and onboard via the SFDP CLI. Mainnet delegation follows once testnet criteria are met.
requirements: Testnet node meeting baseline criteria in ≥5 of the last 10 testnet epochs
Report all metrics throughout the epoch on both testnet and mainnet
Commission ≤5% on mainnet
From May 2026: ASN/hosting provider <25% of network stake and data-center concentration <15%
Adherence to transaction processing/infrastructure standards (transaction-ordering manipulation or censorship prohibited)

pools.name: The Vault
pools.summary: Community stake pool where undirected stake splits between Gauges, Direct Stake Leaders, and an Elite Performance bucket.
pools.howToApply: Apply on The Vault Discord; a community-elected Validator Board reviews every application before allowlisting.
requirements: Uptime ≥97.5%
Commission ≤5% base and ≤10% MEV
0/0 commission required for the Elite Performance bucket
Optionally direct stake through vSOL and hold $V (or incentivize gauge votes) to earn more

pools.name: Jito (StakeNet Steward)
pools.summary: Fully on-chain, permissionless delegation: the Steward program scores all validators each 10-epoch cycle and splits the pool equally among the top ~400.
pools.howToApply: No application — run a qualifying validator with the Jito-Solana client and the Steward includes you automatically when your score ranks top 400. Track your score on the StakeNet dashboard.
requirements: MEV commission ≤10% and priority-fee distribution via TipRouter
Low inflation commission (top scoring tier)
Vote on ≥70% of expected slots (delinquency removal)
No commission rugs — triggers instant unstake

pools.name: Marinade (SAM)
pools.summary: 100% of Marinade's TVL is distributed through the Stake Auction Marketplace: validators bid yield to win stake each epoch.
pools.howToApply: Permissionless: fund a Protected Staking Rewards (PSR) bond on-chain, then place SAM bids. Stake follows the best effective yield offered.
requirements: Funded Protected Staking Rewards (PSR) bond as collateral (prerequisite for SAM participation)
Competitive max_yield bid (static CPMPE and/or dynamic commission) each epoch
Bond must cover reward loss from bid reduction, activating stake fees, and risk reduction mechanism obligations

pools.name: BlazeStake (SolBlaze)
pools.summary: Liquid staking with Custom Liquid Staking (CLS): stakers can direct their bSOL-backing stake 1:1 to a chosen validator; BLZE gauges add more.
pools.howToApply: No formal application for the base pool — eligible validators are included automatically via CLS by having delegators direct their stake. For custom delegation strategies (invite-only beta), contact SolBlaze via email at [email protected] or Twitter @solblaze_org.
requirements: Validator must be online (delinquent validators are excluded)
Must not take 100% of staking rewards in fees

pools.name: JPool
pools.summary: Smart Delegation Strategy re-evaluates validators every epoch and redistributes stake every 5 epochs; 30% of the pool goes to Community Good validators.
pools.howToApply: Automatic once your validator meets the inclusion criteria (check with the Smart Validator Toolkit). Ecosystem builders can apply separately for Community Good status via the CG form.
requirements: Meet JPool performance and reliability criteria (checked every epoch)
Not on Solana Foundation or Jito Foundation blocklists
Community Good track: demonstrate ecosystem impact (scored by committee)

pools.name: Sanctum (own LST)
pools.summary: Note: This program has been deprecated (as of the blog post). Historically, every validator automatically received a Sanctum Automated LST — a liquid token for stake delegated to them. Claiming it unlocked branding and routing benefits.
pools.howToApply: Claim by signing an off-chain message with your identity key (solana sign-offchain-message SANCTUMLSTCLAIM) and completing verification with Sanctum.
requirements: 5% management fee on staking yield (half returned to the validator)
Optional block-reward sharing with LST holders per your published policy
